Round arms and clean style give this chair modern and classic touches, allowing it to blend with most styles. 55.5"W and 72"D when unfolded into bed Solid hardwood and laminate wood frame; polyester/nylon performance fabric Modern casual Doubles as an accent chair and pull-out twin bed No assembly required Free returns for 30 days. 3 year warranty.
